summary: Extended the multi-voter line one step further and kept the whole-question account current in a single interpretation. The two established comparisons stand unchanged: the configuration loss (receipt b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826, violated at witness index 15, control holding at 18) and the minority election (receipt abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407, violated at witness index 22 with the majority side still holding a leader, control holding at 25), both with flag-off controls. On top of that, a new bounded check now tests the client-contract consequence: after the isolated stale-configuration node wins with two of five committed votes, a client Apply was issued on it, on the majority-side leader if any, and after healing the two applied slices were compared. The probe showed the isolated leader accepting and completing the client write (minority_apply_ok true) — an acknowledged duty resting on two of the committed five voters — while no majority-side leader existed in that run, so no conflicting entry and no FSM divergence was produced and none is claimed. That check is submitted as an experiment with its control for a receipt, the gap answer is updated (election resolved by a complete comparison; reproduction explained by requestVote's existing-leader guard; divergence still open, resolved=false), and the diverging probe's negative is retained as a limitation rather than promoted.
